verses.gurmukhi: ਗਿਰਗਟ ਕੈ ਰੰਗ ਕਮਲ ਸਮੇਹ ਬਹੁ ਬਨੁ ਬਨੁ ਡੋਲੈ ਕਊਆ ਕਹਾਂ ਧਉ ਸਵਾਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: giragaT kai ra(n)g kamal sameh bahu ban ban ddolai kuooaa kahaa(n) dhau savaan hai ||

en.bdb: A chameleon who changes the colour of its body so very often looks very much like the form of a lotus flower. But this insect-eating chameleon cannot be holding the merits of a lotus flower. A dead flesh-eating crow that flies here and there cannot reach a swan who eat pearls.

verses.gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਘਰ ਫਿਰਤ ਮੰਜਾਰ ਅਹਾਰ ਪਾਵੈ ਬੇਸ੍ਵਾ ਬਿਸਨੀ ਅਨੇਕ ਸਤੀ ਨ ਸਮਾਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: ghar ghar firat ma(n)jaar ahaar paavai besavaiaa bisanee anek satee na samaan hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a male cat roams about various burrows and houses searching for food, and likewise a whore living life of several vices cannot reach out to a woman of truth, sincerity and virtues.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਰ ਸਰ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਨ ਮਿਲਤ ਮਰਾਲ ਮਾਲ ਜੀਵ ਘਾਤ ਕਰਤ ਨ ਮੋਨੀ ਬਗੁ ਧਿਆਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sar sar bhramat na milat maraal maal jeev ghaat karat na monee bag dhiaan hai ||

en.bdb: Just as wandering from pond to pond, one cannot find a flock of swans who live in lake Mansarover and an egret who kills living beings for food cannot be contemplating.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਹੁਇ ਮਾਖੀ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਚੰਦਨ ਦੁਰੰਗਧਿ ਅਸਥਾਨ ਹੈ ॥੪੬੦॥
verses.translit_en: bin gurdhev sev aan dhev sevak hui maakhee tiaag cha(n)dhan dhura(n)gadh asathaan hai ||460||

en.bdb: Similarly, without the service of perfect Guru, if someone becomes a follower of any other god/goddess, it is like a fly who giving up the fragrance of sandalwood goes and sits on foul smelling filth.  (460)
